event: 2025 ILCA Senior Europeans and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: GBR 224700 was represented by Kai WOLGRAM.
GBR 219895 was represented by James PERCIVAL-COOKE.
The race committee was represented by Javier Blanco (Course representative ILCA 7).
Case No. 16 was heard together with case No. 15 in accordance with RRS 63.2(b) since both hearings arose from the same incident.
GBR 224700 requested a scoring inquiry at 15:52 which was answered at 16:42 stating that the race committee made an improper action, and the race committee would request redress for the boat.
GBR 219895 requested a scoring inquiry at 16:12 which was answered at 16:44 stating that the race committee made an improper action, and the race committee would request redress for the boat.

The race committee submitted a request for redress for GBR 224700 and GBR 219895 at 17:51. Between the decision on the scoring inquiries and the submission of the request the race committee was involved in another hearing. Therefore the race committee submitted the request as soon as reasonably possible after the relevant information was available.
Robert Olsson (member of the race committee) attended the hearing as an observer.
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: For the second start attempt of race 3 for the ILCA 7 Red fleet the black flag was displayed as preparatory signal.
After the starting signal a general recall was displayed by the race committee.
The race committee displayed the sail numbers of GBR 224700 and GBR 219895 before the next start.
GBR 224700 and GBR 219895 did not sail in race 3.
Upon reviewing the records, the race committee found that they made an error in identifying GBR 224700 and GBR 219895 to be scored BFD.
conclusions: GBR 224700’s and GBR 219895's score in race 3 was made significantly worse through no fault of their own by an improper action of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are met. RULES: RRS 61.4(b)(1), 63.2(b), N1.4(b)
decision: Redress is given to GBR 224700 and GBR 219895. GBR 224700 and GBR 219895 are to be scored in race 3 points equal to the average, rounded to the nearest tenth of a point (0.05 to be rounded upward), of their points in all races sailed in the qualifying series, except race 3. No other boat’s score shall change.
